subject.title: feat: show live session activity for running tasks

question: Should the chat activity feature extend the task activity contracts merged in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100789, or should OpenClaw also support this separate `sessions.activity`/`session.activity` and plugin-hook family?
rationale: Both choices create durable Gateway and plugin SDK obligations, and repository policy requires explicit owner direction before adding a parallel public contract.

options.title: Extend Existing Task Surface
options.body: Rebase onto current main, reuse task summaries/events, and add only the missing selected-session tool activity needed by the chat strip.

options.title: Accept Separate Session Contract
options.body: Keep the new RPC, event, and hooks after explicit Gateway/plugin API approval plus compatibility and lifecycle proof.

options.title: Pause This Direction
options.body: Leave the canonical issues open and pause or close this branch until maintainers settle the activity contract.

recommendation.title: Extend Existing Task Surface
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current main, reuse task summaries/events, and add only the missing selected-session tool activity needed by the chat strip.

likelyOwner.reason: The recently merged Tasks implementation creates the immediate current-main overlap and is the best available routing point for the contract choice.
